loops.data_scope: Closed aggregate and artifact evidence from authorized Loops 45-63 only; no new experiment.
controls: clinical claims prohibited without clinical evidence
loops.acceptance_gate: Release only exact claims whose evidence, comparators, uncertainty, privacy, license, reproducibility, and governance gates pass.
loops.kill_or_park_rule: Hold the release rather than soften a failed scientific or governance gate.
loops.future_resource_cap: artifact-only; one thread; <=32 MiB generated; zero new data/model/device operations
loops.authorization_boundary: Claim review cannot retroactively authorize experiments; tag, release, archive, DOI, and public claims require a separate maintainer decision.

cross_loop_kill_branches.response: Keep real training sealed and repair only through a versioned amendment.
Park model scaling; run target-blind Loop48 diagnosis; do not open source test or S25.

cross_loop_kill_branches.trigger: Loop47 intact signal does not beat corruptions
cross_loop_kill_branches.response: Block neural-contribution wording and prioritize shortcut/peripheral controls.

cross_loop_kill_branches.trigger: Loop49 finds no nonfinal development person
cross_loop_kill_branches.response: Keep S25 final-only and hold cross-person execution.

cross_loop_kill_branches.trigger: Loop50 is not positive on every development person
cross_loop_kill_branches.response: Do not freeze or open S25.
Publish the negative zero-shot verdict; S25 is consumed and never calibrated.

cross_loop_kill_branches.trigger: Loop55 EEG effect fails or remains confounded
cross_loop_kill_branches.response: Keep EEG as mechanics/accessibility evidence and do not pursue home decoding.
Park the exact hardware path without substitution.

cross_loop_kill_branches.trigger: Loop60 safety privacy or quality fails
cross_loop_kill_branches.response: Stop the home pilot and retain acquisition-feasibility limits.
Hold release and preserve the discrepancy record.
